request_payload.title: Precision therapy for epilepsy due to KCNT1 mutations: A randomized trial of oral quinidine.

mentions.mention: autosomal dominant nocturnal frontal lobe epilepsy (ADNFLE)
mentions.sentence: METHODS: A single-center, inpatient, order-randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled, crossover trial of oral quinidine included 6 patients with severe autosomal dominant nocturnal frontal lobe epilepsy (ADNFLE) due to KCNT1 mutation.
